### WD-40 Company to Present at Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/753208278/files/doc_news/WD-40-Company-to-Present-at-Morgan-Stanley-Global-Consumer--Retail-Conference-2026.pdf)


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


WD-40 Company (NASDAQ:WDFC), a global marketing organization dedicated to creating positive lasting memories by developing and selling products that solve problems in workshops, factories and homes around the world, today announced that Steve Brass, president and chief executive officer, and Keith Stauffer, chief financial officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at approximately 3:00 p.m. ET in New York City.


A live webcast of this event will be available on the Company’s investor relations website at[http://investor.wd40company.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.wd40company.com&esheet=54640154&newsitemid=20261112036856&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.wd40company.com&index=1&md5=a8db84511579a7e903d7cc5994b641c2) . The webcast will be archived and available on the website for a six-month period following the conference call.


**About WD-40 Company**


WD-40 Company is a global marketing organization dedicated to creating positive lasting memories by developing and selling products that solve problems in workshops, factories, and homes around the world. The Company owns a wide range of well-known brands that include maintenance products and homecare and cleaning products: WD-40® Multi-Use Product, WD-40 Specialist®, 3-IN-ONE®, GT85®, 2000 Flushes®, no vac®, Spot Shot®, Lava®, and Solvol®.


Headquartered in San Diego, California, USA, WD-40 Company recorded net sales of $688.0 million in fiscal year 2026 and its products are currently available in more than 176 countries and territories worldwide. WD-40 Company is traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the ticker symbol “WDFC.” For additional information about WD-40 Company please visit[http://www.wd40company.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.wd40company.com&esheet=54640154&newsitemid=20261112036856&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.wd40company.com&index=2&md5=8e1782ea9eab57d55505dd24d8f2a8b3) .
